intro: Each suggestion is a proposal only. Nothing has been implemented; pick the ones worth doing and they can be added in a later pass.

rows.title: Book the Feb 15–22, 2027 week and lock the 7-night comparison
rows.why: It was the cheapest week across every hotel tested and it matches the requested 7-night cost basis.

rows.title: Get a written all-in quote from the top two hotels
rows.why: Derived totals exclude tax. One itemised quote per hotel removes the guesswork (F-05, F-12).
rows.needs: Email or phone to each property

rows.title: Retry pricing for MGM Grand, Cosmopolitan and Bellagio
rows.why: Three of the four hotels with a Michelin star on campus have no verified price (F-02), which skews the price ranking.

rows.title: Add a real RTC travel-time matrix for the 12 confirmed-hour restaurants
rows.why: The brief's 1-hour rule cannot be honoured without door-to-door minutes (F-16). The RTC trip planner can supply them.
rows.needs: Time to run each origin–destination pair

rows.title: Split the trip: Strip hotel for Michelin nights, Chinatown hotel for the 6-restaurant cluster
rows.why: Chinatown has six Michelin restaurants in one mile but no Michelin hotel; the Strip has the stars but a 20–30 minute ride to Chinatown.
rows.needs: A second hotel quote for a 2–3 night split

rows.title: Collect tasting-menu prices for the 21 unpriced restaurants
rows.why: Food budget cannot be built without them (F-06).
rows.needs: OpenTable/MICHELIN menu pages or direct contact

rows.title: Verify social accounts for the top 10 venues only
rows.why: Verifying all 33 venues is slow; the top 10 cover every starred restaurant and the main activities (F-14).
rows.needs: Checking each platform for a linked official handle

rows.title: Add a total-cost calculator to the site
rows.why: Readers currently have to add hotel + restaurants + transit + shows by hand. A simple sum with clearly-labelled assumptions would speed the decision.
rows.needs: Approval to add an interactive element

rows.title: Shift arrival to Feb 16 to dodge the federal holiday
rows.why: Feb 15, 2027 is Washington's Birthday (F-13); arriving a day later may reduce arrival-day cost and congestion.

rows.title: Decide whether to treat the DMO or MICHELIN as authoritative on Bib Gourmands
rows.why: Two official sources disagree (F-03). Publishing one consistent rule prevents future contradictions.
rows.needs: A stated editorial rule; MICHELIN release recommended

rows.title: Show distance rings on the hotel page
rows.why: The brief wants travel of an hour or less; a simple walking/bus/monorail ring per hotel would make that visual.
rows.needs: Approved map data and a design pass

rows.title: Set a recheck date for every dynamic rate
rows.why: All hotel prices are live and will drift; a single 'recheck by' date keeps the site honest.
rows.needs: Calendar reminder, e.g. 60 days before arrival
